rules.temperature: one noul T over every val (message, tag) pair: the minimiser of the mean binary cross-entropy of sigmoid(m / T) over log T in [0.5, 5.0] (scipy bounded scalar minimiser), a bound winning an exact tie
rules.objective: val micro-F1 at the val-selected global θ on probabilities after the val-fitted T, compared exactly as 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN) of the summed counts
rules.tie_order: equal objectives: fewer epochs first, then the lower encoder LR
rules.epoch_transfer: the final seeds train on final_train with the selection schedule (--epochs 30) and stop after the chosen epoch (--stop-after-epoch), never --epochs k*

theta.tie_break: closest to 0.5; between two equally close points, the lower θ
theta.per_tag: a tag's own θ only with >= 10 val positives, else the global θ
